correctness.rationale: The classical blowup classes E_i, H-E_i-E_j, and 2H-sum_{k!=i}E_k give all 27 lines and an exact skewness test via intersection pairing. Independently reconstructed the 27-vertex Schläfli graph with parameters (27,16,10,8), all 2,763 nonempty cliques and f=(27,216,720,1080,648,72), with no size-seven clique. A separately implemented deterministic greedy matching by vertex scan gave 1,368 disjoint face–coface pairs, 27 critical cells (one 0-cell and 26 dimension-four cells), and topological sorting of all 10,584 directed Hasse incidences visited all 2,763 cells, certifying acyclicity. Therefore Forman yields a CW model with a point and only 26 four-cells; all attachments are null for dimensional reasons. Finite enumeration is exhaustive because the graph has exactly 27 vertices, and the intersection-class argument links it to every smooth complex cubic surface.
residual_risks: It does not determine the Weyl-group representation on H4 or line configurations for singular/real cubic surfaces.

The remarkable nonpure complex has faces through dimension five yet collapses to 26 four-spheres; that complete topological classification is mathematically stronger and more reusable than existing H1 vanishing or graph parameters.
